# Vendored QR library

- Library: qrcode-generator 1.4.4
- Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- License: MIT (see LICENSE and the file header in qrcode-generator.js)

This file is shipped with the static site so the classroom entry QR code is generated entirely in the browser. The page must not depend on an external QR image API.
